The '''Kaleesh Resistance''' was a resistance group that operated among the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] during the [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|conflict]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Under the leadership of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], they held out against the Imperial occupiers for over a [[Standard decade|decade]] until they were finally routed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="aite">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}}</ref>

Thrawn, who was usually able to study his adversaries' art and devise a strategy to defeat them from there, was unable to comprehend Kaleesh's artworks, and so [[Bombardment of Oben|leveled]] [[Oben]] with his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]; inflicting heavy casualties and bringing an end to the insurrection. One of the few survivors was Sk'ar himself, whom subsequently joined the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] out of respect for his former foes' tactics.
